#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Maintain one HTML tracker and export its current prompts, using only the standard library."""

import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import tempfile


DATA = re.compile(r'(<script type="application/json" id="tracker-data">)(.*?)(</script>)', re.S)
STATES = {"to-prepare", "ready", "running", "to-verify", "follow-up", "blocked", "done"}
RESULTS = {"unverified", "passed", "failed", "not-applicable"}


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def read_state(path):
    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    matches = list(DATA.finditer(html))
    require(len(matches) == 1, "Expected exactly one tracker-data block.")
    return html, json.loads(matches[0][2])


def render(html, data):
    require(len(DATA.findall(html)) == 1, "Expected exactly one tracker-data block.")
    payload = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    return DATA.sub(lambda m: m[1] + "\n" + payload + "\n" + m[3], html)


def prompt_path(root, filename):
    relative = Path(filename)
    require(not relative.is_absolute() and relative.parts and relative.parts[0] == "prompts",
            "Prompt files must be relative paths under prompts/.")
    result = (root / relative).resolve()
    require(result.is_relative_to(root.resolve()) and result.is_relative_to((root / "prompts").resolve())
            and result.suffix == ".md",
            "Prompt path escapes the workstream or is not Markdown.")
    return result


def validate(data, root):
    require(isinstance(data, dict), "State must be an object.")
    for key in ("title", "spec", "scope", "updated_at", "next_action"):
        require(isinstance(data.get(key), str), f"{key} must be a string.")
    for key in ("decisions", "journal"):
        require(isinstance(data.get(key), list) and all(isinstance(x, str) for x in data[key]),
                f"{key} must be a list of strings.")
    require(isinstance(data.get("missions"), list), "missions must be a list.")
    missions, exports = {}, {}
    for mission in data["missions"]:
        require(isinstance(mission, dict), "Each mission must be an object.")
        for key in ("id", "title", "ticket", "status"):
            require(isinstance(mission.get(key), str) and mission[key], f"Missing mission {key}.")
        mid = mission["id"]
        require(re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*", mid), f"Invalid mission ID: {mid}")
        require(mid not in missions, f"Duplicate mission ID: {mid}")
        require(mission["status"] in STATES, f"Unknown mission state: {mid}")
        missions[mid] = mission
        for key in ("owner", "chat", "workspace", "checked_at", "blocker", "next_action", "report"):
            require(isinstance(mission.get(key, ""), str), f"{mid}.{key} must be a string.")
        for key in ("depends_on", "remaining", "evidence"):
            items = mission.get(key, [])
            require(isinstance(items, list) and all(isinstance(x, str) for x in items),
                    f"{mid}.{key} must be a list of strings.")
        criteria = mission.get("criteria")
        require(isinstance(criteria, list), f"Missing criteria list: {mid}")
        for criterion in criteria:
            require(isinstance(criterion, dict), f"Invalid criterion: {mid}")
            require(isinstance(criterion.get("text"), str) and criterion["text"].strip(),
                    f"Empty criterion: {mid}")
            require(criterion.get("result") in RESULTS, f"Invalid criterion result: {mid}")
            require(isinstance(criterion.get("proof", ""), str), f"Invalid proof: {mid}")
            if criterion["result"] in {"passed", "not-applicable"}:
                require(criterion.get("proof", "").strip(), f"Evidence or reason required: {mid}")
        if mission["status"] == "done":
            require(criteria and all(c["result"] in {"passed", "not-applicable"} for c in criteria)
                    and not mission.get("remaining") and not mission.get("blocker"),
                    f"Unfinished criteria, work, or blocker in done mission: {mid}")
        if mission["status"] == "ready":
            require(not mission.get("blocker"), f"Ready mission still has a blocker: {mid}")
        prompt = mission.get("prompt")
        if prompt is not None:
            require(isinstance(prompt, dict), f"Invalid prompt: {mid}")
            require(prompt.get("kind") in {"implementation", "follow-up"}, f"Invalid prompt kind: {mid}")
            require(prompt.get("delivery") in {"prepared", "sent", "unknown"}, f"Invalid delivery: {mid}")
            require(isinstance(prompt.get("text"), str) and prompt["text"].strip(), f"Empty prompt: {mid}")
            require(isinstance(prompt.get("file"), str), f"Missing prompt file: {mid}")
            path = prompt_path(root, prompt["file"])
            require(path not in exports, f"Prompt file shared by multiple missions: {path}")
            exports[path] = prompt["text"].rstrip() + "\n"
    visiting, visited = set(), set()

    def visit(mid):
        require(mid not in visiting, f"Dependency cycle at {mid}")
        if mid in visited:
            return
        visiting.add(mid)
        for dependency in missions[mid].get("depends_on", []):
            require(dependency in missions, f"Unknown dependency {dependency} for {mid}")
            visit(dependency)
            if missions[mid]["status"] == "ready":
                require(missions[dependency]["status"] == "done", f"Unmet prerequisite {dependency} for {mid}")
        visiting.remove(mid)
        visited.add(mid)

    for mid in missions:
        visit(mid)
    return exports


def atomic_write(path, content):
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", encoding="utf-8", dir=path.parent, delete=False) as temp:
        temp.write(content)
        temporary = Path(temp.name)
    try:
        temporary.replace(path)
    finally:
        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=("init", "read", "save", "check"))
    parser.add_argument("html", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--title", default="Implementation tracker")
    parser.add_argument("--spec", default="")
    parser.add_argument("--data", type=Path, help="Temporary JSON input for save")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    path = args.html.resolve()
    if args.command == "init":
        require(not path.exists(), f"Tracker already exists: {path}")
        template = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "assets/tracker.html"
        data = {"title": args.title, "spec": args.spec, "scope": "", "updated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                "next_action": "Read the specification and record its tickets and dependencies.",
                "decisions": [], "missions": [], "journal": []}
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for directory in ("prompts", "evidence"):
            (path.parent / directory).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as output:
            output.write(render(template.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), data))
    else:
        html, data = read_state(path)
        if args.command == "save":
            require(args.data is not None, "save requires --data.")
            data = json.loads(args.data.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        exports = validate(data, path.parent)
        if args.command == "read":
            print(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
            return
        if args.command == "save":
            for output, content in exports.items():
                require(not output.exists() or output.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == content,
                        f"Preserve existing prompt; choose a new follow-up filename: {output}")
            for output, content in exports.items():
                if not output.exists():
                    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    with output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
                        stream.write(content)
            data["updated_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
            atomic_write(path, render(html, data))
        if args.command == "check":
            for output, content in exports.items():
                require(output.exists() and output.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == content,
                        f"Missing or divergent prompt export: {output}")
            refs = [data["spec"]] + [m.get("report", "") for m in data["missions"]]
            for reference in refs:
                if reference.startswith("/"):
                    require(Path(reference).exists(), f"Missing local source: {reference}")
    print(f"{args.command}: OK — {path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except (ValueError, OSError) as error:
        raise SystemExit(str(error))
